howItWorks.title: How Cotonia works
howItWorks.subtitle: A wholesale marketplace built around the way kids’ clothing is really traded: in series, with direct conversations between buyers and suppliers.
howItWorks.retailersIntro: Boutiques, online stores, chains and distributors.
howItWorks.r1Text: Create a free retailer account. We verify every business, so suppliers know they’re dealing with real shops.
howItWorks.r2Title: Find products or post a request

howItWorks.r3Text: Ask suppliers about colours, labels and lead times. Add series to your cart; each supplier gets its own order request.
howItWorks.r4Text: The supplier confirms stock and shipping. You pay using their payment terms and follow the order until it arrives.

howItWorks.w2Text: Add each model with its size run, colours, stock and price tiers. No photo yet? We show a clean illustration.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything about buying and selling on Cotonia.

items.a: A series (also called a size run or pack) contains one piece of each size in the run. For example, a 4-piece series of a dress in sizes 2Y, 3Y, 4Y and 5Y gives you one dress in each size. You order series per colour.

Cotonia is for businesses: boutiques, online stores, chains and distributors that sell children’s clothing. Registration is free, and our team verifies each business before prices and ordering are unlocked.
Wholesale prices are only shown to verified retailers. This protects our suppliers’ pricing and keeps the marketplace professional. Log in or register your shop to see them.
You pay the supplier directly, using the payment terms shown on their store page and on your order. Usually this is a bank transfer. The supplier marks the order as paid once the payment arrives.
When you send an order request, choose whether the supplier ships to your address or you use your own cargo agent. The supplier confirms stock and adds the shipping cost before you pay.
Each product has a minimum number of series, and each supplier can set a minimum order value. Your cart shows exactly what is still missing.

items.q: Can I order from several suppliers at once?
items.a: Yes. Your cart groups products by supplier, and checkout sends a separate order request to each one.
If you can’t find exactly what you need, post a buying request with the quantity, target price and details. Suppliers send you quotes and you can chat with them before ordering.
Register as a wholesaler and add your company details and products. Once our team approves your store, buyers from around the world can find you, message you and place orders.

about.title: About Cotonia
about.intro: Cotonia is a global B2B marketplace for children’s clothing. Its name comes from cotton, the soft, natural fabric at the heart of children’s clothing.
about.mission: We make it easy for independent kids’ clothing shops anywhere in the world to buy directly from manufacturers, and for manufacturers to find new buyers beyond their home market.
about.value1Text: Every business is reviewed before it can sell or see prices.
about.value2Text: Buyers and suppliers talk directly, without middlemen in between.
about.value3Text: Series, minimum orders, price tiers and buying requests work the way wholesale really works.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.subtitle: Questions about your account, a supplier or an order? We’re here to help.
contact.emailText: We reply within one business day.
contact.suppliersText: Use the Contact supplier button on any product or store page. Your conversation is saved in your Messages.

sections.title: 1. The marketplace
sections.body: Cotonia provides an online marketplace where business buyers (retailers) and business sellers (wholesalers) can find each other, communicate and agree on orders. Cotonia is not the seller of the products listed.

sections.title: 2. Business accounts
sections.body: Accounts are for businesses only. You must provide accurate company information, keep your login details safe, and tell us about any changes. We may review, approve, suspend or close accounts to protect the marketplace.

sections.title: 3. Orders and payments
sections.body: An order request becomes binding once the supplier confirms it. Payment terms, delivery and returns are agreed between buyer and supplier, as shown on the supplier’s store page and the order.

sections.title: 4. Listings and content
sections.body: Suppliers are responsible for their product information, photos, prices and compliance with product safety rules in the countries they sell to. We may hide listings that break these terms.

sections.title: 5. Fair use
sections.body: Do not use Cotonia to send spam, collect other members’ data, or move conversations off the platform to avoid these terms.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Account details (name, email, phone), business details (company name, address, country), and the activity needed to run the marketplace, such as orders, messages and buying requests.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: To run your account, verify businesses, deliver messages and orders between buyers and suppliers, keep the marketplace secure, and improve our service.

sections.title: Who sees it
sections.body: Suppliers see the business details you share on an order or in a conversation. We don’t sell personal data. Service providers that host the platform process data on our behalf.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data at any time by contacting us. Some records, such as orders, may be kept as required by law.
